# Singapore Work Trip Plan: 14–19 Sep 2026

A practical 5-day plan for one traveler, centered on the CBD, with a hotel shortlist, a work-friendly schedule, and a compact packing list. Budget target is **SGD 2,400 total excluding flights**.

## CBD Hotel Picks for Business Travel

| Option | Area | Why it fits | Typical nightly range | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Carlton City Hotel Singapore** | Tanjong Pagar | Strong CBD location, desks, reliable Wi‑Fi, MRT nearby | SGD 260–380 | Best balance of work + transit |
| **Oasia Hotel Downtown** | Tanjong Pagar / CBD edge | Walkable to offices, modern rooms, good business setup | SGD 280–420 | Style + central access |
| **The Fullerton Hotel Singapore** | Raffles Place / Marina | Excellent prestige address, easy MRT, business-ready rooms | SGD 420–650 | Premium client-facing trip |
| **M Hotel Singapore City Centre** | Tanjong Pagar | Often good value for CBD stays, work desks, MRT access | SGD 220–340 | Budget-conscious business stay |

## 5-Day Work Trip Itinerary

### Day 1: Arrival, settle in, and light evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in near Tanjong Pagar or Raffles Place, test Wi‑Fi, set up workspace.
- **Afternoon:** 4 hours of meetings or prep calls; keep the first day lighter to absorb jet lag.
- **Exercise:** 1 hour easy walk along Marina Bay or hotel gym session.
Media: Alt=Exercise:** 1 hour easy walk along Marina Bay or hotel gym session, Singapore
- **Dinner:** **Tiong Bahru Hainanese Boneless Chicken Rice** or a nearby CBD hawker center for a low-effort local meal.
- **Tip:** Buy an EZ-Link card or use contactless payment for MRT rides.

### Day 2: Full meeting day in the CBD
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Breakfast, then 2 hours of meetings.
- **Afternoon:** 2 more hours of meetings; keep breaks short and structured.
- **Exercise:** 1 hour at the hotel gym or a brisk loop around Marina Bay.
- **Dinner:** **Lau Pa Sat** for satay, noodles, or seafood in a central setting.
- **Tip:** Book a quiet café or business lounge backup in case a meeting runs long.

### Day 3: Meetings + client-friendly dinner
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/briefcase.svg
- **Morning:** 2 hours of meetings, then a short admin block for email and follow-ups.
- **Afternoon:** 2 more hours of meetings or a coworking session near the CBD.
- **Exercise:** 1 hour swim or treadmill session.
- **Dinner:** **Amoy Street Food Centre** for a broad local selection close to the office core.
- **Tip:** If you need a polished dinner, choose a restaurant in Marina Bay or Tanjong Pagar.

### Day 4: Buffer day for longer sessions
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- **Morning:** 2 hours of meetings.
- **Afternoon:** 2 hours of meetings, then one hour for planning and expense tracking.
- **Exercise:** 1 hour walk-run route along the Singapore River or gym.
- **Dinner:** **Chinatown Complex Food Centre** for affordable local dishes and easy MRT access.
- **Tip:** Use this day as your catch-up buffer if earlier meetings overrun.

### Day 5: Final meetings and departure prep
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- **Morning:** Final 2 hours of meetings and send wrap-up notes.
- **Afternoon:** Last 2 hours of meetings, then pack and check out.
- **Exercise:** 1 hour light walk and stretch session before departure.
- **Dinner:** **Maxwell Food Centre** if you have time before heading out, or a simple hotel-area meal.
- **Tip:** Keep your laptop, charger, passport, and any receipts in your carry-on for a smooth departure.

## Budget Plan for SGD 2,400 Total

| Category | Planned spend | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel | SGD 1,250–1,650 | 5 nights in the CBD, business-standard room |
| Meals | SGD 220–350 | Mix of hawker dinners and one or two nicer meals |
| Local transport | SGD 40–80 | MRT, occasional taxi/ride-hail |
| Coffee/snacks | SGD 60–120 | Meeting days and convenience items |
| Exercise / wellness | SGD 0–60 | Hotel gym usually included; occasional day pass if needed |
| Buffer / misc. | SGD 150–250 | Laundry, printing, small contingencies |

**Practical target:** stay near **SGD 1,900–2,200** so you keep a cushion for last-minute meeting changes or a nicer client dinner.

## Packing Checklist for a Singapore Business Stay

### Work essentials
- Laptop, charger, mouse, and power adapter
- Phone, cable, power bank
- Passport, ID, travel insurance, meeting confirmations
- Notebook, pens, business cards
- Portable HDMI/USB-C adapter if presenting

### Clothing
- 5 work outfits, breathable fabrics
- 1–2 smart-casual evening outfits
- Lightweight jacket or blazer for meeting rooms
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Socks and undergarments for 5–6 days
- Sleepwear and gym clothes

### Health and comfort
- Refillable water bottle
- Small umbrella or packable rain jacket
- Basic medication, plasters, hand sanitizer
- Sun protection for outdoor walking
- Laundry bag and a few stain wipes

### Singapore-specific useful items
- Contactless payment card or card-enabled wallet
- Plug adapter if your devices need one
- Booking details saved offline
- A small foldable bag for shopping or laundry
